title: Biomagnifications
definition: The progressive increase in the concentration of non-biodegradable, persistent, and fat-soluble substances (like heavy metals or pesticides) at successive trophic levels of a food chain.
importanceInUpsc: Frequently tested in Environment & Ecology (Prelims) and Disaster Management/Pollution (Mains). It links toxicology, food security, and biodiversity loss.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Biomagnifications.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
